% Pattern: proof/amsthm/article. A sentence between a statement and its
% proof, and a proof inside a sloppypar.
% from 0910.5574, math/0003117
% want proposition-1 statement/proposition 1 status=here
% want proof-1 proof - proves=proposition-1 flag=text-between
% want proposition-2 statement/proposition 2 status=here
% want proof-2 proof - proves=proposition-2
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{amsthm}
\newtheorem{proposition}{Proposition}
\begin{document}
\begin{proposition} Each tree is a graph. \end{proposition}

In particular, each forest is a graph.

\begin{proof} A tree has no cycle. \end{proof}
\begin{proposition} Each path is a tree. \end{proposition}

\begin{sloppypar}
\begin{proof} A path has no cycle. \end{proof}
\end{sloppypar}
\end{document}
